long_description:

This vibrant multi-media show will feature approximately 620 singers and dancers from Tawa’s six primary schools, Tawa Intermediate, Tawa College and the Tawa community.  The programme features a variety of songs and includes Wiata and hits from Coldplay, Ed Sherran, Elton John, Laufey, Dragon, a medley of Wicked songs and many more. Some songs are choral numbers, while others are accompanied by dance, choralography, props and special effects.

id: Real Black for Me: Zoe Moon presents the music of Roberta Flack-Tawhiri Warehouse, Wellington, NZ-Ticket Master
name: Real Black for Me: Zoe Moon presents the music of Roberta Flack
long_description:
Zoe Moon (Mahal) returns to Wellington Jazz Festival with Real Black for Me, a powerful tribute to the soul icon Roberta Flack, an artist whose voice could fill a room or break a heart with a whisper.

Moon's Silver Scroll-nominated single "THE LETTER" and charting release "In Person" have established her as one of Aotearoa's most compelling emerging artists. She has performed on world-renowned stages including the North Sea Jazz Festival, Montreux Jazz Festival and the Hollywood Bowl.  

Be there at Tawhiri Warehouse for this unforgettable celebration of the legendary Roberta Flack.

id: Te Ao Kohatu: Hikurangi Schaverien-Kaa-Tawhiri Warehouse, Wellington, NZ-Ticket Master
name: Te Ao Kohatu: Hikurangi Schaverien-Kaa
long_description:
Acclaimed Ruawaipu and Ngati Porou dummer-composer Hikurangi Schaverien-Kaa is the 2026 Wellington Jazz Festival commissioned artist. A defining force in Te Whanganui-a-Tara's music community for two decades, he has brought his distinctive voice to stages and studeios across Aotearoa and beyond.

Created especially for the Festival, Te Ao Kohatu draws on the striking claim that while the iwi of Te Tairawhiti arrived on many waka, some also descend from the stones themselves. The work explores contested whakapapa, cosmogony, and the space between Maori and Pakega constructions of knowledge, (pre-)history and identity.

All Tickets are Mobile Ticket Only. 
Mobile Tickets are like Print-at-Home tickets but instead of having to print off the tickets yourself, you can just show the barcode on your mobile phone. It is the easiest way to access tickets to your events. For more information visit Ticketmaster.co.nz/mobileticket
